{{Top|leg}}
'''The Grand Design''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located near the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]]. It was rather famous for its original decor and architecture: the entire bar was built in a circular revolving builind, with everything inside revolving too. The cantina had revolving tables, revolving [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreens]], revolving drink glasses and even some revolving chairs the regulars used to avoid.
